title: Society goes off the rails | Institute for Family Studies
gist: A World magazine column teaser (via IFS) by Julie Smyth using the 'Cornell Seven' case, fraternity brothers accused of sexually assaulting a young woman in October 2024, as a springboard for a broader argument about social decay. The excerpt gives only the case outline; the argument is not in the text.

insights.claim: The 'Cornell Seven', former Chi Phi fraternity members at Cornell, are accused of sexually assaulting a young woman in October 2024, and the case re-ignited online controversy.
insights.speaker: Institute for Family Studies
insights.so_what: Campus sexual-misconduct litigation is a reputational and legal exposure for universities.
